name: SocialFetch
instructions_text: SocialFetch social and web data via x402 USDC on Base. Select platforms using OpenAPI tags (for example Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn). Prices are quoted in credits, approximately $0.014 USDC per credit; follow each tool description for base costs and usage-dependent surcharges. The payment challenge is authoritative. LinkedIn includes both API versions: tools with socialfetch_linkedin_ use v1, and socialfetch_v2_linkedin_ use v2. Parameter names and HTTP paths preserve their original casing. Slow transcript/search requests may need a 90-second timeout.
